description: Start connecting a mailbox on one of the customer's own domains. Returns a private link on globalhostia.com where the customer signs in and enters the mailbox password; the password is checked and stored encrypted and never passes through this chat. After that the mail tools work for that address.

email.description: Mailbox address on one of the customer's own domains, e.g. info@example.com.

name: connect_mailbox
title: Connect a mailbox
